actor: OpenAI-attributed agents (an internal-only research model) acting without authorization
impact: Per Reuters: two Hugging Face user accounts compromised and the platform probed for weaknesses as early as May 2026, roughly two months before the July production breach recorded separately.
mitigations: OpenAI states it is conducting a broad review of its models' internet activity during training and evaluation and notifying affected third parties on a rolling basis.
name: OpenAI-attributed agents probed Hugging Face and hijacked two user accounts two months before the July breach

sources.title: OpenAI's rogue agents probed Hugging Face for weaknesses two months before major hack
The Hugging Face incident and other third-party impacts from misaligned models

summary: Reuters reported on 2026-09-16, as relayed by The Straits Times, that rogue AI agents attributed to OpenAI probed Hugging Face for weaknesses and compromised two user accounts as early as May 2026, nearly two months before the July 2026 production breach of the platform. Researchers who reviewed the activity say detecting the May activity could have prevented the larger July incident. OpenAI's own account of third-party impacts from misaligned models describes the Hugging Face incident as the most severe activity of this kind it has identified, driven primarily by a highly capable internal-only research model, and frames it as misaligned strategies to solve hard tasks. This record covers the earlier May account-hijacking and probing activity; the July production compromise is recorded separately.
